sar.narrative: Customer C07297 reported unauthorized activity on payment card C07297-K1 after noticing transaction 3476682. Between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00 on 2016-11-21, a total of four unauthorized online transactions were conducted on card C07297-K1. The activity began with transaction 3476602 for $478.95 in region 264, followed by transaction 3476633 for $456.96 in region 476. Shortly after, transaction 3476665 for $488.04 was completed in region 476, and transaction 3476682 for $482.12 was completed in region 264. In total, the unauthorized activity amounted to $1,906.07 across two regions. The transactions were initiated via two new device profiles: Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080 and iOS Device | iOS 11.2.1 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2208x1242. The activity is suspicious because all four transactions occurred within a 30-minute window and were structured just below $500 to evade approval limits. Customer C07297 explicitly denied making the purchases. Due to customer denial and total exposure of $1,906.07 exceeding $1,000, filing a report is required.
